  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Classify one ice frame}

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
root <- Sys.getenv("DSEAMS_ROOT", unset = "")
tip <- file.path(root, "input", "traj", "exampleTraj.lammpstrj")
# R CMD build sets DSEAMS_ROOT so the package can link. Evaluating the
# engine inside that build overflows the C stack knitr leaves. Set
# SEAMS_VIGNETTE_EVAL=1 to run the chunks.
run <- Sys.getenv("SEAMS_VIGNETTE_EVAL", unset = "")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = nzchar(run) && nzchar(root) && file.exists(tip))
```

This vignette classifies the in-tree mixed TIP4P dump. The engine has
to be on the link line (`SEAMS_LIBDIR`) and `DSEAMS_ROOT` has to point
at a seams-core checkout. Set `SEAMS_VIGNETTE_EVAL=1` as well. Without
those, the chunks stay unevaluated.

```{r}
library(dseams)
tip <- file.path(Sys.getenv("DSEAMS_ROOT"), "input", "traj", "exampleTraj.lammpstrj")
frame <- read_frame(tip, type = 2L)
ice <- chill_plus(frame)
table(ice$name)
table(chill_plus(frame, graph = "mutual")$name)
head(primitive_rings(frame, max_depth = 6L))
head(steinhardt(frame, order_l = 3L))
```

`graph = "cutoff"`, the default, is the distance list. `graph = "mutual"`
is the mutual four-neighbour list. On this dump the default and the cutoff
list give 9 interClathrate and 241 water, and the mutual list gives
1 clathrate, 7 interClathrate, and 242 water. The
columns are a data.frame, so the usual subsetting works.
